address: Ayazağa, Kemerburgaz Caddesi No:7G, İç Kapı No:7, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34396, Türkiye
bio: Start your meal with the wood-fire grilled onion stuffed with rice, spices and currants – a speciality of the house. And be sure to sample the other mezze, such as the piping-hot lahmacun topped with succulent lamb, mint, parsley and a judicious squeeze of lemon. The main courses featuring various cuts of lamb are to die for. This contemporary restaurant close to Vadistanbul Shopping Mall and Galatasaray's football stadium is a celebration of Anatolian culinary heritage.
